params.name: id_program_type
params.description:
The program type ID, which will be one of the [RsProgramTypeSid](#/components/schemas/RsProgramTypeSid) constants.

`0` to not filter Purchase Options

items.docs:
Returns introductory promotion offers available at the specified location, optionally filtered by program type,
including pricing, duration, visit limits, and access information for each item.

info.name: Returns promotion list of the specified business.

params.name: is_franchise
params.description:
Determines whether to return promotions created by Enterprise Locations (for Enterprise Cloud businesses only).
If `true`, promotions created by Enter

params.name: k_business
params.description: The business key used to get the promotions.

items.docs:
Returns all active promotions for the given business, with optional inclusion of Enterprise Location promotions
when the business is a franchisor and `is_franchise` is set to `true`.

Accepts the full promotion configuration including title, description, access rules, duration, tags, and guest
pass settings, then validates and persists the changes.

info.name: Retrieves guest passes for a specific client.

params.name: k_class
params.description:
Class key to filter guest passes by.

`null` if guest passes should not be filtered by class.

params.name: k_location
params.description:
Location key to filter guest passes by.

`null` if guest passes should not be filtered by location.

items.docs: Returns all guest passes assigned to the given user, optionally filtered by class and location.
